periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Vertical-oblique orientation, approximately 70 degrees relative to the horizontal facial axis, tapering toward the snout.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Elongated oval morphology with a pronounced vertical major axis.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Significant downward tapering where the inferior margin extends notably further from the geometric center than the superior margin.

dorsal_band_topology.vertex_curvature_index: Broad U-shaped posterior boundary across the scapular region.
dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: High relative thickness, occupying approximately 40-50% of the visible upper torso length.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: Wide horizontal separation across the cranium, with the gap width exceeding the transverse width of a single ear.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Smooth, convex semicircular curvature at the superior boundaries.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct, dark linear mark or streak is visible on the upper right quadrant of the forehead, extending diagonally toward the crown.
